name: topdown_controller
title: Top-down 4-directional character controller
summary: A CharacterBody2D that moves on WASD/arrows, snaps to the four cardinals, remembers its facing and drives an optional AnimatedSprite2D.
usage: Attach scripts/topdown_controller.gd to a CharacterBody2D with a CollisionShape2D. Set four_way=false for eight-way movement. Point sprite_path at an AnimatedSprite2D whose SpriteFrames has walk_down/walk_up/walk_left/walk_right (and idle_*) and it animates itself; otherwise connect facing_changed to your own drawing.
